dialogue_texts: My, what an untidy tear in the canvas.
Someone has been playing with the boundaries of space and time without asking for my permission first.
The local fabric isn't just torn, My Majesty - it's practically cross-contaminating.
The closer we get to the Shirogane Manor, the more the glohm will try to overwrite our physical laws.
Stray variables... Intruders tracking dirt across the threshold of a flawless equation.
Oh, my dear child, your math is beautifully constructed...
But you've entirely forgotten to account for the margin of error. And currently, I am in that margin.
That's Helene, but the glohm has completely hijacked her magical channels.
She's operating purely on the anomaly's logic right now.
To speak of erasing boundaries in front of me... how terribly bold.
Let's see if your rigid little matrix can handle the boundary between a calculated certainty and absolute chaos!
Let us see if your gaps can withstand the pressure of absolute variance!
